How settling up works

Each expense is divided equally. The calculator nets everyone’s payments and shares, then finds the fewest transfers that clear all balances. Splitting just one bill with tip? Use the split bill calculator. Sharing a lease? Try the split rent calculator.

Frequently asked questions

How do I split expenses when different people paid?

List everyone, add each expense with who paid, and the calculator works out each person’s balance and the fewest payments needed to settle up.

How do I split money for a group trip?

Add every shared cost during the trip. At the end, the settle-up list shows who should pay whom, so you avoid many small transfers.

What is the easiest way to split cost between friends?

Add each shared cost as it happens and let the calculator net everything out. Everyone then makes only the payments shown.

Are expenses always split equally?

In this tool, yes. Each expense is divided equally among everyone listed. For uneven shares of a single bill, see the split bill calculator.
